WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT p.ID,
         p.SEX,
         AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
         AVG(l.HGB) / AVG(l.HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
stats_with_mean AS (
  SELECT ID,
         SEX,
         avg_wbc,
         ratio,
         AVG(ratio) OVER () AS mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT ID,
       SEX,
       avg_wbc,
       ratio,
       ratio - mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_overall_mean
FROM stats_with_mean
WHERE ratio > mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_overall_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
